next.reason: 1985: "The RERUN clause for the Indexed I-O module is a subset of the RERUN clause for the Sequential I-O module."; 2023: "FMT-12.4.6.2: I-O-CONTROL . [ [ apply-commit-clause] . ] [ [ { same-clause }… ]. ] (no RERUN clause)". The 2023 I-O-CONTROL format allows only APPLY COMMIT and SAME clauses. RERUN is gone, so the 1985 rule on the Indexed I-O RERUN clause has no counterpart.
